# Puddle rewrite catalog

Generated on 2026-10-22 from the working tree at `5d4a6b8a9e8da2262f08025fc51307622beb530a` (`math-fehr/instsimplify-proofs`).

**1,703 renderings**, covering all **534 discovered production `Pattern OpCode` declarations** under `Veir/`: 472 builder definitions, 3 direct record definitions, and 59 aliases or dispatchers. The renderings also include concrete instances extracted from compiled pass patterns. Generic builders are covered through the displayed instances; compiler-generated auxiliary declarations and unit tests are excluded.

The output comes from the Lean [Puddle pretty printer](../Veir/PatternRewriter/Puddle/PrettyPrinter.lean), after simplifying builder state with the rules used by `unfoldPuddleBuilder`. Every rendering retains the complete `where` block, including types, properties, guards, and native computations. This is reading notation, not an input format.

## Parameter coverage

- Scalar parameters remain symbolic when they do not determine graph structure. Boolean graph choices and the supported finite opcode/shape selectors are expanded.
- Scalar-literal families cover integer, zero-marker, and poison constructors. For `IS5122`, integer conditions use `0` and `1` to represent the two possible i1 values; selected integer payloads remain symbolic.
- Unbounded GEP families use representative graph sizes: 0–3 dynamic indices, 0–2 zero-index payloads, and 0–2 dynamic indices on each side of a poison index. These samples do not enumerate every arity. The two `Core` definitions are direct-record versions of builder families and are included too.
- Generic pass helpers use their concrete pass instances. Comparison lowering includes its supported 8-, 32-, and 64-bit forms; widening keeps the target width symbolic. Arbitrary combinations of opcode/helper parameters are not enumerated.

**Variant 1:** `payloads = []; representative length 0, a b : Int`

```text
llvm: getelementptr(X)  =>  X

  X : T0
  require (Array.filter (fun x => x == -2147483648) P0.rawConstantIndices.values).size == 0 &&
    P0.rawConstantIndices.values.all fun index => index == 0 || index == -2147483648
  T0 : Veir.LLVM.PointerType
```

**Variant 2:** `payloads = [a]; representative length 1, a b : Int`

```text
llvm: getelementptr(X, a)  =>  X
where

  P0 = properties(C0)
  root = getelementptr(X, C0) : T0
  P1 = properties(root)
  X : T0
  require (Array.filter (fun x => x == -2147483648) P1.rawConstantIndices.values).size == 1 &&
    P1.rawConstantIndices.values.all fun index => index == 0 || index == -2147483648
  require Veir.InstSimplify.intConstantGuard P0 a
  T1 : Veir.IntegerType, where t = T1: BitVec.ofInt t.bitwidth a == 0
  T0 : Veir.LLVM.PointerType
```

**Variant 3:** `payloads = [a, b]; representative length 2, a b : Int`

```text
llvm: getelementptr(X, a, b)  =>  X
where

  P0 = properties(C0)
  C1 = b : T2
  P1 = properties(C1)
  root = getelementptr(X, C0, C1) : T0
  P2 = properties(root)
  X : T0
  require (Array.filter (fun x => x == -2147483648) P2.rawConstantIndices.values).size == 1 + 1 &&
    P2.rawConstantIndices.values.all fun index => index == 0 || index == -2147483648
  require Veir.InstSimplify.intConstantGuard P1 b
  T2 : Veir.IntegerType, where t = T2: BitVec.ofInt t.bitwidth b == 0
  require Veir.InstSimplify.intConstantGuard P0 a
  T1 : Veir.IntegerType, where t = T1: BitVec.ofInt t.bitwidth a == 0
  T0 : Veir.LLVM.PointerType
```

#### Veir.InstSimplify.IS1430.pattern

**Parameters:** `n : Int`

```text
llvm: shl(X, n)  =>  mlir.zero()
where
  C0 = n : T0
  P0 = properties(C0)
  root = shl(X, C0) : T0
  P1 = properties(root)
  new2 = mlir.zero() : T0 [created]

  | x => false
```

[Source module](../Veir/InstSimplify/IS1534.lean)

#### Veir.InstSimplify.IS1534.pattern_or

[Source](../Veir/InstSimplify/IS1534.lean#L8)

**Variant 1:** `reversed = false; flipped = false; commute = false`

```text
llvm: (icmp((X - Y), 0) | icmp(X, Y))  =>  C5
where
  C0 = 0 : T0
  P0 = properties(C0)
  a1 = (X - Y) : T0
  P1 = properties(a1)
  a2 = icmp(a1, C0) : T1
  P2 = properties(a2)
  a3 = icmp(X, Y) : T1
  P3 = properties(a3)
  root = (a2 | a3) : T1
  P4 = properties(root)
  C5 = mlir.constant() : T1 [created]
  P5 = properties(C5)
  X : T0
  Y : T0
  require P3.predicate ==
    bif false then
      Veir.InstSimplify.swapCmpPred (bif false then Veir.Data.LLVM.IntPred.uge else Veir.Data.LLVM.IntPred.ule)
    else bif false then Veir.Data.LLVM.IntPred.uge else Veir.Data.LLVM.IntPred.ule
  require P2.predicate == Veir.Data.LLVM.IntPred.ne
  T1 : Veir.IntegerType
  T0 : Veir.IntegerType
  require Veir.InstSimplify.bitConstantGuard T0 P0 0
  require match T1.val with
  | Veir.Attribute.integerType t => t.bitwidth == 1
  | x => false
  P5 ← match T1.val with
  | Veir.Attribute.integerType t => some { value := Veir.LLVMConstantValue.integer (Veir.IntegerAttr.ofInt 1 t) }
  | x => none
```

```text
llvm: (icmp((X + C0), k1) & icmp(X, C0))  =>  C6
where

  P0 = properties(C0)
  C1 = k1 : T0
  P1 = properties(C1)
  a2 = (X + C0) : T0
  P2 = properties(a2)
  a3 = icmp(a2, C1) : T1
  P3 = properties(a3)
  a4 = icmp(X, C0) : T1
  P4 = properties(a4)
  root = (a3 & a4) : T1
  P5 = properties(root)
  C6 = mlir.constant() : T1 [created]
  P6 = properties(C6)
  X : T0

  require P3.predicate == Veir.Data.LLVM.IntPred.ult

  require Veir.InstSimplify.bitConstantGuard T0 P0 k0
  require Veir.InstSimplify.bitConstantGuard T0 P1 k1
  require match T0.val, T1.val with

  | x, x_1 => false
  P6 ← match T1.val with
  | Veir.Attribute.integerType t => some { value := Veir.LLVMConstantValue.integer (Veir.IntegerAttr.ofInt 0 t) }
  | x => none
```

#### Veir.widenConstant

[Source](../Veir/Passes/Legalization/LegalizerHelper.lean#L61)

**Parameters:** `width : Nat`

```text
gmir: g_constant()  =>  g_trunc(C1)
where
  root = g_constant() : T0
  P0 = properties(root)
  C1 = g_constant() : T1 [created]
  P1 = properties(C1)
  new2 = g_trunc(C1) : T0 [created]
  P2 = properties(new2)
  T0 : Veir.IntegerType, where t = T0: decide (t.bitwidth < width)
  T1 = Veir.TypeAttr.of Veir.IntegerType (Veir.IntegerType.signless width)
  P1 ← match P0 with
  | { value := { value := value, type := { bitwidth := w, signedness := signedness } } } =>
    some
      {
        value :=
          Veir.IntegerAttr.ofInt (if w % 8 = 0 then value else ↑(BitVec.ofInt w value).toNat)
            (Veir.IntegerType.signless width) }
  P2 = { nsw := false, nuw := false }
```
